annotations.title: Check a video's length against the networks

description: Whether a post's video is short enough for each account's network: per account ok, reason, max_seconds (null when no limit is on file for that network) and actual_seconds. Without accounts it checks the accounts the post is for. A video whose length is not known yet answers an empty list. Approving a post with a video over a target's limit is refused with NETWORK_LIMIT.

accounts.description: Accounts from accounts_list; default: the post's own accounts
